title.zh: 新增背景数据库与互操作专题部分

summary.zh: 新增五章系统讨论背景数据库的演进谱系、系统模型与方法论分歧、基本流与影响评价方法的耦合约束、过程与产品流跨库映射的根源障碍，以及数据交换格式与互操作治理边界。
summary.en: Added five chapters examining background LCI database lineages, system-model divergences, elementary-flow coupling with LCIA methods, barriers to cross-database process mapping, and exchange-format interoperability.

title.zh: 发布中英双语在线版并统一语言前缀路径

summary.zh: 全书正文、专题、附录与参考装置均发布中英双语版本，分别位于 /zh/ 与 /en/ 路径下；原无语言前缀的旧网址保留自动跳转。
summary.en: Published complete Chinese and English editions under /zh/ and /en/ across all chapters, topical essays, appendices, and reference pages, with automatic redirects preserving prior URLs.

title.zh: 新增生命周期评价发展大事记与对应附录
title.en: Added Interactive LCA Historical Timeline and Print Appendix

summary.zh: 新增 1969–2026 年生命周期评价关键研究、方法框架、数据库与法规节点的可视化大事记及全书连续版对应附录，明确区分据原始文献与据转述两类出处。
summary.en: Added an interactive 1969–2026 timeline and matching print appendix tracking landmark studies, frameworks, databases, and policies, distinguishing primary-source entries from secondary accounts.

title.zh: 合并五组拆分章节并统一网页与连续版章号
title.en: Consolidated Five Split Chapter Pairs and Unified Numbering

summary.zh: 将原网页中分为两篇的五组章节合并为完整单章，使网页目录与全书连续版章次一一对应；原网址及各节锚点均保留自动跳转。
summary.en: Consolidated five previously split web chapter pairs into unified chapters matching the continuous print numbering, while preserving automatic redirects and section-anchor mappings for prior URLs.

title.zh: 更正章节合并后的表号与跨章旧篇名引用
title.en: Corrected Cross-Chapter Table Numbers and Prior Chapter Titles

summary.zh: 更正章节合并后正文内多处误指“表 1”（实应为“表 2”）的表号引用，并将跨章互引中残留的合并前旧篇名更新为现行章名。
summary.en: Corrected internal references that pointed to Table 1 instead of Table 2 after chapter consolidation, and updated residual pre-merge chapter titles in cross-references to current titles.

title.zh: 更正混合清单算例中的内部章节编号引用
title.en: Corrected Chapter Reference in Hybrid Inventory Discussion

summary.zh: 将混合清单算例说明中残留的旧编号指向更正为现行对应章名《墙面服务比较》。
summary.en: Replaced a stale draft chapter number reference in the hybrid-inventory discussion with the current Wall Service Comparison chapter.

title.zh: 补正中点—终点开篇示例的清单输入与路径范围
title.en: Clarified Inventory Input and Pathway Scope in Midpoint–Endpoint Examples

summary.zh: 明确前版开篇示例仅讨论排放后路径，补充土地占用、化石能源、原生矿产开采，以及停在物理暴露量的平流层臭氧耗竭与电离辐射路径说明。
summary.en: Clarified that earlier opening examples illustrated emission pathways only, expanding the scope to land use, fossil and mineral extraction, and stratospheric ozone depletion and ionizing radiation pathways.
